unstated.quote: self.assertTrue('can not parse package.yaml: missing required fields' in output_stderr)

instruction_covers: Non-zero exit on failure is retained
Underlying tool's error message ('can not parse package.yaml: missing required fields') must be surfaced verbatim, which the instruction requires ('surface whatever the underlying build tool said')
